evidence.quote: Multi-AZ is offered in ElastiCache for Valkey and ElastiCache for Redis OSS. Memcached does not support replication or failover natively so Multi-AZ is not offered in ElastiCache for Memcached.
All ElastiCache Serverless caches run Multi-AZ.
